metadata.description: Nowely's plugins for Codex and Claude Code.

plugins.name: entrust
plugins.description: Orchestrate subagents in Claude Code or Codex: agree a plan, delegate scoped tasks, verify independently and synthesise attributable results. Adapters run external Codex agents with per-call rights, evidence gates and receipts, external Claude agents through `claude -p`, and OpenCode workers or an OpenCode coordinator; helpers clean up, advise, run swarms and turn your sessions into feedback on a skill.

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Three skills you invoke to assess and improve a standalone text: `audit` measures it, `rethink` agrees its shape, and `rewrite` writes it. `clarity` is reader-side guidance the assistant may choose while writing an answer, plan, commit, PR, comment, message, or agent brief; it starts no agents. The deep skills use agents, work in a run directory and ask before applying a text to your files.
